evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Rep never asked the two-concerns question about moving on time or damage to items.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Not applicable; no concerns were raised by customer in step 2.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Rep made no mention of value days or pricing flexibility based on the October 17th date.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rep said 'there's no deposit required, no resending your spot' but never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' The ask was absent; instead rep said 'if ever you're interested then just feel free to let us know.'

top_strength: Zhang gathered comprehensive logistics details systematically — current and destination addresses, square footage, room count, access concerns, special items (washer, dryer, massage chair, bed frames), parking, and confirmed packing status — covering nearly all the probing checklist.
coaching_note: Step 2 is the foundation: you never asked the two-concerns question about on-time movers or damage, so you missed the chance to anchor the promises and validate the customer's real fears before pricing, and step 6 (final concerns check) was also missing, leaving the call without bookend moments or a genuine attempt to close the business.
